activity.notes: Purea was a high-ranking Tahitian woman of the Papara ruling community. Early European visitors sometimes treated her as a queen of Tahiti, but Tahiti was not a single centralized monarchy under her. ATLAS therefore binds her to Papara and records the politically prominent 1767-1768 period without inventing a pan-Tahitian queenship.

sources.title: Purea — South Seas Companion
sources.citation_text: The South Seas Companion describes Purea as a high-ranking Maohi woman associated with Papara and her efforts in 1767-1768 to promote her son's political status.
